hints.title: Coordinate Tree Representation
hints.text: Extract depth d, position p, and value v from each three-digit integer. Store values in a map keyed by (d, p).

hints.title: Child Coordinates
hints.text: For a node at depth d and position p, its left child is at (d + 1, 2 * p - 1) and its right child is at (d + 1, 2 * p).

hints.title: Leaf Detection and Path Sum
hints.text: Traverse recursively from (1, 1) carrying the running path sum. If neither child exists in the coordinate map, the node is a leaf, so add the accumulated path sum to the answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of encoded node triplets
complexity.notes: Hash map coordinate indexing followed by depth-first path accumulation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding explicit node pointer structures adds unnecessary overhead for compact coordinate trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mapping (depth, pos) coordinates allows O(1) direct child lookups at (depth + 1, 2 * pos - 1) and (depth + 1, 2 * pos).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use mathematical coordinates (depth + 1, 2 * pos - 1) and (depth + 1, 2 * pos) for child nodes and accumulate running path sums at leaves.
